gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-encode-sans-expan: Distinctive is the first word that comes to mind for Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe-wide c and flat, uniform strokes. Encode Sans Expanded follows in a plain sans, wide and friendly, with little stroke variation to slow the eye.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-encode-sans-sc: Cherry Swash lets its curves and stems move in lockstep, giving the headline a bold, sign-painted presence. And Encode Sans SC stays out of its way, a sans with a shallow curl at the terminals and a generous gap.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Encode Sans Semi Condensed reads modern and friendly, its s opening up in a way that keeps lines easy to follow. Cherry Swash, bent like pipe cleaner, supplies the texture above it.

Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its rounded letters left open, giving text a contemporary, unfussy feel. But Cherry Swash above it is heavier, with n arches as thick as its stems, so the plain sans below reads lighter.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-exo: Exo has wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, and it comes across as approachable and tidy. Exo handles the quiet reading, while Cherry Swash, with horizontals as thick as its verticals, handles the shouting.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic reads modern and businesslike, its rounded letters left clearly open. Faculty Glyphic against Cherry Swash's strokes, which look like bent steel rod, is the strongest thing about this pairing.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-fahkwang: Approachable is Fahkwang's best trait, with a faint nib-pressure shift across each round letter and curves that finish before they close. And Cherry Swash, with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon, adds a firmer, blunter voice above.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-figtree: Cherry Swash opens with a horseshoe-wide c and a commanding, uniform stroke. But Figtree, drawn as if with a marker tip, gives the pair its strongest quality: a friendly modern counterweight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-finlandica: Finlandica gives e crossbars open mouths and outlines you could follow with a finger. Finlandica keeps a plain sans rhythm that stays comfortable well beyond the heading's bold opening.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-fustat: Modern and contemporary, Fustat draws lines like bent rope or tubing, with a clear gap where the c ends. Fustat against Cherry Swash's heavy horseshoe c is where the pair gets its strongest character.
